name: ghost-fibers

frames.best_why: Both the dotted diagonal ribbon and the bright folded crest at the top are visible at once against the dark.

tagline: A dim lavender river of stitched dots ripples across black.
summary: An almost-black backdrop with a slow current of tiny lilac fibers twisting through it in soft-focus ribbons. The strands glow at the folds and drift all the time, with a faint answer to the pointer.
appearance: On near-black a wide band of minute lavender dots sweeps diagonally like embroidery on folded cloth, brighter along one curved crest at the top. Ends and edges blur into soft haze and a few loose specks.
behaviour: The dotted ribbon keeps flowing and twisting, its folds brightening as they catch the light and dimming as they turn away. Moving the cursor bends the fibers nearby and shifts focus; clicking sends a faint pulse of light along the strand.
use_when: A dark, low-contrast backdrop behind large type or product shots that need quiet motion.
avoid_when: It is extremely dark, so it almost disappears on bright displays and in most screenshots.
customise: Props set glow, line and secondary colours, gradient direction, speed, scale, rotation, layer and thread counts, twist, waves, fiber style, depth of field, bloom, grain and pointer response.
weight_why: Instanced fiber beads plus five bloom passes and a composite shader run every frame.

a11y.note: The canvas is hidden as decoration, but the wrapper has no role or name and the pointer reaction has no key path.

issues: The effect is so dark that most of the fiber detail is barely visible.
Frames differ only slightly, so the motion is hard to read from stills.
polish_why: Fine fiber detail and soft bloom, but the near-black exposure hides most of the craft.
title: Ghost Fibers
